claim: At checkout, a single item priced 2.675 is charged 2.68, and three items at 0.335 each are charged 1.01 in total.
why: to_cents converts the float through str, so Decimal sees 2.675 exactly and rounds half up to 2.68. The sum of three 0.335 prices is rounded once and gives 1.01. The README warns of round-down from binary floats, which does not apply because of the str conversion.

root.claim: At checkout, a single item priced 2.675 is charged 2.68, and three items at 0.335 each are charged 1.01 in total.

atoms.claim: A single item priced 2.675 is charged 2.68
atoms.evidence: Ran main.py: total([2.675]) prints 2.68. to_cents uses Decimal(str(amount)) with ROUND_HALF_UP.

atoms.claim: Three items at 0.335 are charged 1.01 in total
atoms.evidence: Ran main.py: total([0.335, 0.335, 0.335]) prints 1.01; the sum is rounded once.
